name: Purify Water
blurb: Tablets and twenty minutes turn a bottle of murk into something safe.

name: Tear Dressings
blurb: Rags torn into strips. It will stop the bleeding — it will not stop what gets in afterwards.

name: Lash a Knife Spear
blurb: A kitchen knife taped to a length of timber. Keeps them at arm’s length.

name: Lash a Cleaver Spear
blurb: Heavier at the tip than a knife spear, and it bites deeper for it.

name: Lash a Parang Spear
blurb: The best of them — and it costs you the best blade you own.

name: Strip for Parts
blurb: Scrap is heavy and worth nothing. Parts are light and repair things.

name: Reload Shells
blurb: Handloading. Ugly, slow, and the only ammunition anyone still makes.

name: Stitch a Sleeping Bag
blurb: Rags and tape into something you can sleep in. Heavy, but better than the floor.

name: Laminate an EZ-Link Knife
blurb: Four spent cards and a scrap edge. STA will not take them as tribute anymore.

name: Bend a Lockpick
blurb: Two scraps bent into a rake and a tensioner. One door, maybe.

name: Drive Nails Through a Bat
blurb: Ugly, loud, and it tears more than it hits. The nails bend after a while.

name: Wrap Your Hands
blurb: Rag and tape over the knuckles. It is barely anything, and it is better than nothing.

name: Lash Shin Guards
blurb: Flat scrap padded with rag and taped to the shins. Legs are what they go for low.

name: Lash a Scrap Shield
blurb: Two sheets, a zip-tied handle, and an arm that will ache by evening.

name: Cut a Padded Vest
blurb: Foam soaks a bite better than it soaks a blade. You will miss it at bedtime.

name: Beat Out a Scrap Helm
blurb: A bucket of hammered plate with rag inside. You will not hear much coming.

name: Rivet a Scrap Plate Vest
blurb: Plate over rag over you. It stops teeth. It also announces every step you take.

name: Cut a Tarp Poncho
blurb: A head hole and taped seams. Dry and drab — but that tarp was your roof.

name: Strap the Torch to Your Head
blurb: The same light, and your off hand back. Worth an hour of fiddling with zip ties.

name: Cook Cooked Noodle Soup
blurb: Needs a cooking pot and heat for the whole preparation. Cook with carried water or a hot batch left here. Eat before it spoils.

name: Cooking Fire
blurb: Stays at this surface location. Provides 24 in-game hours of heat from completion, including time spent away.

name: Fixed Stove
blurb: Build a permanent stove at this surface location, then fuel it. It cannot be packed or carried.

name: Fuel the Stove
blurb: Stays at this surface location. Provides 24 in-game hours of heat from completion, including time spent away.

name: Rain Collector
blurb: Stays here. Collects one water per three rainy hours, up to four. Collected water needs treatment.

name: Rain Shelter
blurb: Stays here. Gives an open sleeping site a roof, without protection from enemies.

name: Boil Water Here
blurb: Boil two carried waters in a pot. The batch stays here, hot for two hours, then remains clean. Collect it to carry, or use it in recipes.

name: Cut a Stick into Firewood
blurb: Trade a useful pole for fire fuel.

name: Fold Paper Tinder
blurb: Dry paper starts a fire; it does not fuel a whole day.

name: Use Joss Paper as Tinder
blurb: Dry paper becomes an emergency fire starter.

name: Use a Spent Ticket as Tinder
blurb: Give up a possible barter token for a fire starter.

name: Use an Ang Bao as Tinder
blurb: A dry envelope has one last practical use.

name: Salvage a Powerbank
blurb: Recover usable cells with tools. The powerbank is consumed.

name: Strip a Bicycle Repair Kit
blurb: Recover useful repair parts from the kit.

name: Make a Bottle Rain Collector
blurb: A small bank of bottles under a tarp. Same four-water capacity as the bucket collector; stays here.

name: Make Saucepan Helmet
blurb: Everyday supplies turned into modest protection or carrying gear. Crafting consumes the original items.

name: Make Towel-Padded Vest
blurb: Everyday supplies turned into modest protection or carrying gear. Crafting consumes the original items.

name: Make Magazine Shin Guards
blurb: Everyday supplies turned into modest protection or carrying gear. Crafting consumes the original items.

name: Make Improvised Sling Bag
blurb: Everyday supplies turned into modest protection or carrying gear. Crafting consumes the original items.

name: Make a Treated Bedroll
blurb: A padded sleeping layer treated with repellent. Counts as bedding; it does not stop ambushes.

name: Cut a Towel into Rags
blurb: Trade a towel for dressings, bindings or padding.

name: Assemble a Battery Lantern
blurb: Reuse the lamp parts and cable inside a bottle housing. Requires a toolbox.

name: Bend Jewellery Wire into a Pick
blurb: Sacrifice valuable jewellery for a one-use lockpick.
